Presets públicos (não funcionam com Surfe)Public presets (don't work with Surfe)Public presets (don't work with Surfe)

Por que preciso disso? O navegador bloqueia chamadas diretas para api.surfe.com (CORS). Proxies públicos removem o Authorization — Surfe retorna 401. A única rota confiável é rodar seu próprio Cloudflare Worker (snippet abaixo, deploy grátis em 2 min). Why is this needed? The browser blocks direct calls to api.surfe.com (CORS). Public proxies strip Authorization — Surfe returns 401. The only reliable path is running your own Cloudflare Worker (snippet below, 2-minute free deploy).Why is this needed? The browser blocks direct calls to api.surfe.com (CORS). Public proxies strip Authorization — Surfe returns 401. Cloudflare Worker (copie · cole · deploy em 2 min) Cloudflare Worker (copy · paste · deploy in 2 min)Cloudflare Worker (copy · paste · deploy in 2 min) 
// Surfe CORS proxy — handles preflight + host allowlist
const ALLOWED_TARGET_HOSTS = ['api.surfe.com'];
const CORS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET,POST,PUT,PATCH,DELETE,OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Authorization,Content-Type,X-Requested-With,Accept,Origin',
  'Access-Control-Max-Age':'86400',
  'Vary':'Origin'
};
export default {
  async fetch(req){
    if(req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:CORS});
    const u = new URL(req.url);
    const target = u.searchParams.get('url');
    if(!target) return new Response('missing ?url=',{status:400,headers:CORS});
    let t; try{ t = new URL(target);}catch{ return new Response('invalid url',{status:400,headers:CORS}); }
    if(!ALLOWED_TARGET_HOSTS.includes(t.hostname))
      return new Response('host not allowed',{status:403,headers:CORS});
    const h = new Headers(req.headers);
    ['host','origin','referer','cookie','cf-connecting-ip','x-forwarded-for'].forEach(k=>h.delete(k));
    const hasBody = !['GET','HEAD'].includes(req.method);
    const r = await fetch(t.toString(),{method:req.method,headers:h,body:hasBody?req.body:null,redirect:'follow'});
    const out = new Headers(r.headers);
    ['content-security-policy','x-frame-options'].forEach(k=>out.delete(k));
    Object.entries(CORS).forEach(([k,v])=>out.set(k,v));
    return new Response(r.body,{status:r.status,statusText:r.statusText,headers:out});
  }
}

Depois do deploy, cole https://seu-worker.workers.dev/?url= no campo acima. After deploy, paste https://your-worker.workers.dev/?url= in the field above.After deploy, paste https://your-worker.workers.dev/?url= in the field above.
